Bidaya (بداية, Arabic for "beginning") is a management and tech consultancy based in the UAE. It acts as the executive layer for funded startups and established SMEs that don't have one yet: CEO, CFO and COO scope across company setup, operations, finance and tech, run inside the business by one firm, engaged monthly or for fixed-scope projects. Published terms: monthly engagements from AED 12,000; the first month carries no notice; every engagement can end on thirty days' notice; unpaid discovery ends at the thirty-minute call; when a business doesn't need a monthly engagement Bidaya says so in writing. Where you stand is a free read on a UAE business (what's covered, what needs building, what's yours to do, and what is due with the cost of missing it), shown in full without an email. Programs are partnership structures co-delivered with cultural and educational institutions for creative businesses and practitioners.
